tagline: NSE: TRIVENI (TEIL) ~Rs 9,200 Cr | Triveni Turbine (TTL, already independent since 2010) ~Rs 18,000 Cr | NEW spin-off TPTL not yet separately listed
summary: Source sheet's 'Triveni' demerger/value-unlock note is now disambiguated: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd (TEIL, sugar + power transmission + other segments) is demerging its power-transmission business (1:3 ratio, record date Jul 22, 2026) into a newly separately-listed entity, Triveni Power Transmission Ltd (TPTL), with listing expected around Aug 2026.
